distinctions.future_tax_policy: Frozen 2026 federal/eligibility assumptions, unknown future law
distinctions.historical_sources: Current revisions, incomplete daily financing and index publication discrepancies are not a posterior probability distribution
distinctions.regime_and_financing: Unweighted specification/cost sensitivity; no calibrated coverage or model weights
distinctions.sampling: Prior independent-seed numerical intervals conditional on fixed assumptions
distinctions.structural: Explicit shocks outside historical support; no event probabilities or assured execution through halts

limitations: Ordinary distributions are hypothetical; not actual fund tax predictions
Projected XNYS calendar, assumed daily execution, no unexpected closure tape
Drawdowns use taxes paid plus terminal payable; not daily tax-on-liquidation valuations
No certified investment rankings, margin, derivatives or advanced-tax support implied
All taxable zero-residual cases blocked; raw initial ordinary-sale tax values superseded
Roth issuer default rerun with zero unpaid-distribution recovery; original full-recovery values retained as unweighted structural sensitivity
Only two registered old anchor paths reused, not an empirical probability or convergence study
